title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override kd22 k50 δ0.12 emb_k=17 seed=1 (DAQB)
abstract: Seed replicate of current best: fixed-λ (0.605) MPB-GraphFWPCA with DAQB at kd=22, k=50, δ=0.12, emb_k=17, rng_seed=1; targets ≥0.744 with PCR≈1.0 and stable cLISI.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.12,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=1
    )
